Keep Command's class docstring reachable so its doctest runs (#6) (#11)

A __doc__ property hid the class docstring from doctest and help; a
descriptor now returns the docstring on the class and the command's help
on an instance. The new doctest wraps pwd, so it joins POSIX_ONLY_DOCTESTS.
